title: Freeform video
description: The fallback when no other skill owns the request: a custom video of any kind, such as an intro for a talk, a birthday clip, an abstract loop, a music visual, an event countdown or an internal update. Covers turning a vague request into a short plan (purpose, length, aspect, one-line message, three to six beats), picking a visual idea, and the craft rules every video shares. Load it when search finds no clear format match.
summary: The fallback for anything without a format: a short plan, one visual idea, built well.

requires.why: One frame per beat proves the plan made it to screen.
A few hits on the key moments instead of silence.

route.deliverable: A custom video that fits no named format
askFirst: Where will it play, and how long should it be?
What should someone feel or do after watching?

triggers: make a cool intro for my talk
a birthday video for my friend
